## Overview

**Daichi Ren** — the current monk Grandmaster of the Jade Wardens, the eastern barbarian tribe of Kythoria. He leads the order in their dual traditions of martial discipline and spiritual study, overseeing the temples, monasteries, and training grounds scattered throughout the eastern territories.

---

## Role

As Grandmaster, Daichi Ren presides over the central settlement that serves as both the political and spiritual heart of the Jade Wardens. Under his leadership, the great masters teach, warriors train, scholars conduct their studies, and important decisions concerning the eastern frontier are made. He is the successor to a lineage that traces back to Soren Kaien, who died in the first battle against Khar'Zul.
